# nemau kubernetes cluster create

Create a cluster.

The control-plane size is either --control-plane-flavor or the three
--control-plane-vcpus, --control-plane-ram and --control-plane-disk values.

Without --node-pool, the cluster gets the console's default pool: "workers",
class "default-worker", 3 nodes of 2 vCPU, 4096 MB and 20 GB (or of the
--worker-flavor size when it is set). Each --node-pool declares one pool
instead; repeat the flag for several:

```
--node-pool name=<name>[,class=<class>][,replicas=<n>][,flavor=<id> | ,vcpus=<n>,ram=<MB>,disk=<GB>][,autoscaler-min=<n>,autoscaler-max=<n>]
```

In a --node-pool, class defaults to "default-worker", replicas to 3 (or to
autoscaler-min when the autoscaler is set), and the size to --worker-flavor,
else to 2 vCPU, 4096 MB, 20 GB. Add pools to a running cluster with
"nemau k8s node-pool add".

Provisioning takes several minutes; raise --timeout if needed.

## Usage

```
nemau kubernetes cluster create <name> [flags]
```

## Examples

```sh
nemau k8s cluster create prod --version v1.31.0 \
  --control-plane-vcpus 2 --control-plane-ram 4096 --control-plane-disk 20

nemau k8s cluster create prod --version v1.31.0 --control-plane-flavor <flavor-id> \
  --node-pool name=workers,replicas=3,vcpus=4,ram=8192,disk=50 \
  --node-pool name=batch,autoscaler-min=1,autoscaler-max=10,flavor=<flavor-id>
```

## Options

```
      --class string                  ClusterClass to use
      --control-plane-disk int        disk in GB per control-plane node
      --control-plane-flavor string   control-plane flavor
      --control-plane-ram int         memory in MB per control-plane node
      --control-plane-replicas int    number of control-plane nodes, 1 to 9 (odd: etcd needs a quorum) (default 3)
      --control-plane-vcpus int       vCPUs per control-plane node
      --node-pool stringArray         a node pool, as name=<name>[,class=<class>][,replicas=<n>][,flavor=<id> | ,vcpus=<n>,ram=<MB>,disk=<GB>][,autoscaler-min=<n>,autoscaler-max=<n>] (repeatable; default: one "workers" pool)
      --version string                Kubernetes version (required)
      --worker-flavor string          flavor of the node pools given no size
```

## Global options

```
      --api-url string           API origin (default: $NEMAU_API_URL, then https://api.nemau-cloud.com)
      --idempotency-key string   key making a write safe to repeat: 1-128 characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : - (default: generated)
  -o, --output string            output format: table, json (default "table")
      --project string           target project, by id or by name (default: $NEMAU_PROJECT_ID, then the saved project)
  -q, --quiet                    print ids only
      --timeout duration         how long to wait for one operation (default 30m0s)
      --wait                     wait for asynchronous operations to finish (default true)
```
